note: A fisheye surround-view GMSL2 camera (rolling shutter, 140 dB HDR, IP69K), useful as a wide wrist or base camera. Entered with the default lens ("Lens Option 1 ... Default lens provided by e-con"): 196.7 (H) x 155.1 (V) degrees and ">=200" (D); the diagonal is a bound, so dfov_deg is null. Lens option 2 is 121 (H) x 96.7 (V) x 164.5 (D) degrees; edit the entry for it. A horizontal FOV above 180 degrees cannot be a pinhole: the lens model is Kannala-Brandt (kb) fitted to the stated angles, an ASSUMPTION (no projection or coefficients are stated). Fixed focus, 0.5 m to infinity. Frame rate "3MP @ 30fps", UYVY; the stream size is not stated, so no stream is entered (active area 1920 x 1536). power_w is the stated typical 1.332 W (12 V). size_mm: "Enclosure with lens - 25mm x 25mm x 48.53mm", entered as [48.53, 25, 25] on the reading that the long side is along the optical axis (an ASSUMPTION). Mass is not stated (null).
interface: GMSL2 (FAKRA connector, cable up to 15 m)
